subject: HANDOFF: P0 INNER wake causal-chain identity gap confirmed; instrumentation-first candidate ready for Manager review
body: Research handoff for ticket 02-p0-inner-wake-causal-chain. Confirmed on current main 7127c287: the physical wake path is generation-fenced but cannot uniquely correlate one accepted opening to later logical-display/frame/presentation milestones. Generation can span multiple opening attempts. Gen3 independently mints opening movementId but that identity is not propagated into wake or typed opening telemetry. Recommended smallest robust instrumentation change: mint openingAttemptSequence at semantic entry to OPENING_FROM_CLOSED; key with serviceEpoch; propagate through WakeInner/Binder/display/frame/transaction/Gen3 milestones; retain generation and connectionEpoch only as stale-work fences; terminalize on reversal/privilege loss/service destroy; keep diagnostics observation-only. Cycle 2 oracle passed 9/9. Cycle 3 remains physical Fold7 gated. No production integration performed.
